full_judgment: 7. On perusal of the impugned judgment we noticed that the High Court Division narrated the pleadings of the parties noted down the submissions of the learned counsel of the parties and then observed the Joint District Judge while dismissing the suit arrived at a positive finding to the effect that the Board of Trusty (sic) in respect of the plaintiff deity voluntarily took the compensation money in due course of acquisition therefore the plaintiff is thus stopped as per section 115 of the Evidence Act to plead new logic that the acquisition of 1960 is void abolition. The learned Joint District Judge upon consideration of the evidence and materials on record arrived at a findings that the suit is barred by article 142 of the Limitation Act, since the plaintiff could not substantiate his pleading to the effect that he was dispossessed from the suit property on 25th February, 1989 rather it was also found that the plaintiff was dispossessed from the suit property since 14th June, 1960 thereafter possession was never restored in their favour despite the alleged &requisition which was challenged in Writ Petition No. 554 of 1989 knocking the said order of derequisition and the subsequent order dismissing the leave petition in civil petition for leave to appeal No. 23 of 1999 upholding the order of the High Court Division in respect of said derequisitioning vide Ext. E. from a plain reading of the impugned judgment it appears that the learned Joint District Judge elaborately discussed the entire evidence of P.W. therefore the grievance raised by the learned Advocate for the appellant in that respect is not sustainable and dismissed the appeal on the reasoning that the learned Joint District Judge has evaluated the entire evidence on record and arrived at a positive finding which could not have been assailed by the learned counsel for the plaintiffs with reference to the materials on record.
